title: Why Stealing a Horse & Buggy from Walmart Is a BAD Idea
description:
Michigan police stumbled upon a strange sight in a gas station parking lot in January — an abandoned horse and buggy. After further investigation, they found out an Amish reported their transportation was stolen while they were shopping at Walmart nearly three miles away. Find out how officers uncovered the mystery of the stolen horse and buggy on this Law&Crime BodyCam.

Subscribe to Law&Crime BodyCam: https://bit.ly/LawAndCrimeBodyCam
